data.name: Learn the Story
data.description: A storyteller becomes a master at learning a place's tales. He can perform for a full minute, spending 10 rounds of storyteller's performance, to gain the effects of retrocognition.

raw_tokens.value: A storyteller becomes a master at learning a place's tales. He can perform for a full minute, spending 10 rounds of storyteller's performance, to gain the effects of retrocognition.
He can spend 1d4 × 10 minutes and 10 rounds of storyteller's performance to gain the effects of legend lore. The subject must be at hand for the legend lore to function.|PRECLASS:1,Medium=10
The storyteller can spend a standard action and 1 round of storyteller's performance to gain the effects of vision on any subject.|PRECLASS:1,Medium=19
